name: Gen-X Home
summary: Gen-X Home is an interior design and a casual architectural style that gained prevalence from the late 1990s through the early 2000s.
description: Gen-X Home is an interior design and a casual architectural style that gained prevalence from the late 1990s through the early 2000s. It features, high-quality durability, home accessability, a pragmatic balance of eclectic / bold self-expression and nostalgia which moves away from the over-the-top exaggeration and the full minimalism in a balanced contrast of the 1980s, where this aesthetic leans on structured, cozy spaces incorporating built-in entertainment centers, early technology integrations and warm wood elements. It is described as the softer home marketing segment version of Corporate Cyberspace [ 1 ] .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Simplicity, authenticity, comfort
